import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data - use correct paths from Data Overview
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Drop rows with NaN in coordinates from training data (only valid ones)
train_df = train_df.dropna(
    subset=[
        "pickup_latitude",
        "pickup_longitude",
        "dropoff_latitude",
        "dropoff_longitude",
    ]
)
train_df["fare_amount"] = train_df["fare_amount"].fillna(0)

# Fill test fare_amount with NaN (for validation)
test_df["fare_amount"] = np.nan


# Feature engineering function
def create_features(df, is_test=False):
    df = df.copy()

    # Extract time features from pickup_datetime
    df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(df["pickup_datetime"], errors="coerce")
    df["hour"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    df["day_of_week"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
    df["month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month

    # Distance between pickup and dropoff (approximate)
    df["distance"] = np.sqrt(
        (df["dropoff_latitude"] - df["pickup_latitude"]) ** 2
        + (df["dropoff_longitude"] - df["pickup_longitude"]) ** 2
    )

    # Log of distance
    df["log_distance"] = np.log1p(df["distance"])

    # Distance to center (Manhattan area proxy)
    df["distance_to_center"] = np.sqrt(
        (df["pickup_latitude"] - 40.7128) ** 2
        + (df["pickup_longitude"] - -74.0060) ** 2
    )

    # Passenger count features
    df["passenger_count"] = df["passenger_count"].astype(int)
    df["passenger_count_bin"] = (df["passenger_count"] // 2) + 1

    return df


# Apply feature engineering
X_train_full = create_features(train_df.copy())
y_train = train_df["fare_amount"]
train_keys = train_df["key"].values

X_test = create_features(test_df.copy())
test_keys = test_df["key"].values

# Define feature columns
feature_cols = [
    "pickup_latitude",
    "pickup_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "passenger_count",
    "passenger_count_bin",
    "hour",
    "day_of_week",
    "month",
    "distance",
    "log_distance",
    "distance_to_center",
]

# Proper hold-out validation split (model should NEVER see this during training)
val_ratio = 0.1
val_size = int(len(X_train_full) * val_ratio)
X_val = X_train_full.iloc[:val_size]
y_val = y_train.iloc[:val_size]
X_train_fold = X_train_full.iloc[val_size:]
y_train_fold = y_train.iloc[val_size:]

# Optimize LightGBM parameters for faster training within time limit
params = {
    "objective": "regression",
    "metric": "rmse",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 15,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "random_state": 42,
    "min_child_samples": 10,
    "max_depth": 4,
    "n_estimators": 500,
    "force_row_wise": True,
    "seed": 42,
}

# Create datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train_fold[feature_cols], label=y_train_fold)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val[feature_cols], label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# Train model with early stopping and limited boosting rounds
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=300,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(30, verbose=False, first_metric_only=True)],
)

# Predict on validation set
val_preds = model.predict(X_val[feature_cols])

# Calculate validation RMSE (genuine hold-out estimate)
rmse_val = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, val_preds))
print(f"Validation RMSE (hold-out): {rmse_val:.6f}")

# Predict on test set (UNLABELED data for submission)
test_preds = model.predict(X_test[feature_cols])

# Create submission file - ensure correct format per competition requirements
submission = sample_submission.copy()
submission = submission.reset_index(drop=True)
submission["fare_amount"] = test_preds
submission["key"] = test_keys
submission["fare_amount"] = submission["fare_amount"].astype(float)
submission = submission[["key", "fare_amount"]]

# Save submission to correct path
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Test predictions shape: {test_preds.shape}")
print(f"Submission columns: {list(submission.columns)}")
